pages.text: While you are $(l)online$() but away from the temple, favor $(l)accrues$() at the rate you last saw in person and is credited when you come back nearby (capped).$(br2)A temple you have not yet watched in person accrues at a $(l)discounted$() estimate; stay away too long and accrual pauses.

While you are $(l)offline$() nothing is produced (servers may configure otherwise).$(br2)The inspector's "While you're away" section shows the current state: rate per day, any discount, whether it is paused, and how much is waiting for you.
